'''Squallburgers''' was a dish containing [[Squall (species)|squall]] meat from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. It was most commonly served in lower-class diners in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].
